content: Yesu Pailatla bahikeibong

Ubiyactebenang depec-baba ngic micne, nga Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele damongfocngineng, ailu Wapongte yefe-yowale wewedu ngic, nga Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele Tutumangtowale memba sasawa, yenge yowa hefeibong. Hefelu Yesu moleine dodockelu Pailatla bahikelu yele molewa loibong.
Balu hikebong Pailatdi Yesu yanguc uwacnowec, “Ga Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele ngictau, me?” Inguc mime bafaliyelu yanguc edowec,
Aime depec-baba ngic micne yenge Yesu yowawa lolu fungineine bocyac miibong.
Inguc mibong Pailatdi hatacmac uwacnowec, “Yenge gale yowa bocyacbenang migaing, yogo ngagelu ameine monic mi bafaliyegic, me?”
Inguc mime Yesu ye ameine hatacmac mi bafaliyecnome, Pailat ye kwatackewec.
Yesu wehomaningte mimoctoibong

Aime Ewalicebaicnele hombangte damengsoc yanguc ailu gawec. Ngic monic muc-macka ngiyeme, Yuda ngic-ngigac yengi yele wac wackebong, Pailat ye ngic yogo lukecnolu muc-mackacni hegileme wahikecaigac, inguc ailu gawec.
Aime ngic gocne esecne ngic-ngigac kwele fangke-fangke aibaba, ailu ngic gocne wehomacebabong muc-macka locebaibong, yengelacni ngic monic wacine Barabas.

Aime depec-baba ngic micne yenge Yesu moc hasowac aicnolu Pailatle molewa lonogale bahikeibong, ye yogo biyac ngagewec. Inguc ngagelu habutowa yenge kwesilu Pailat ye aibaba ailu gawec, yogo ingucnehac ainale uwacnoibong. Uwacnobong yedi ameine yanguc bafaliyelu uwayelewec, “Yuda ngic-ngigac ngengele ngictau lukengelebele ngagegaing, me?”
Inguc mime depec-baba ngic micne yengi habu kpafengebabong, yenge Yesu hegilelu Barabas lukecnonale miibong.
Inguc mibong Pailat ye hatacmac bafaliyelu yanguc uwayelewec, “Aime na Yuda ngic-ngigac ngengele ngictau migaing, yele wenuc aidacte?”
Uwayeleme yengi aukwelu wackelu miibong, “Ga ye malicpongka weng homana.”
Inguc mibong Pailatdi hatacmac uwayelewec, “Aime ye oma sowacne aiwec?” Inguc mime yengi hatacmac dacineholec aukwelu wackelu miibong, “Ye malicpongka weng homana!”

Inguc mibong Pailat ye habu yengele ngage-ngage balaibenogale ngagelu, Barabas lukecnome yengela hauwec. Aime yengi Yesu socine muc-hududi welubac, malicpongka weningte hudu-baba ngic yengele molewa lolu hegileyelewec.
Mife-miwa aicnoibong
Aime hudu-baba ngic yenge Yesu balu gamang yengele macte oda kwelina felu mibong, hudu-baba ngic sasawadi kpaduckeibong.

Kpaduckeyackelu misulec aicnoningte ngictaule ngakpi dalicne ingucne monic mondo-sasac holecnobong hauwec. Haume ngictaule duu ingucne muc-somang monic patiyelu hingoc ingucne hodocina holecnobong hauwec.
Haume alang bacno-bacnole silic ingucne ailu wackelu yanguc edoibong, “Ohec, Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele ngictau.”
Milu yasudi hodocina welu sofockelu higeina ketadi holecnolu milockeibong.
Ailu yenge misulec aicnobong motome, ngakpi dalicne mondo-sasac yogo hemoctocnolu yeicne ngakpiine hatacmac holecnobong haume, malicpongka wenogale balu lobina hikeibong.
Malicpongka weibong

Aime Sairini taonkacni ngic monic wacine Saimon, ye Aleksanda nga Rufus yekele mamacnginec, ye nosing-bolewacni yefewa welewec. Weleemewa hudu-baba ngic yengi Yesule malicpong tengkenale dogbac aicnobong tengkeme hikeibong.
Hikebong yenge himong bulilicine monic wacine Goligata, yogolec fungine Hodoc-luwe, iwa Yesu balu hikeibong.
Bahikelu marasing monic wacine mira,
yogo waingkolec lalickelu lacnoibong. Aime ye yogo hegilewec.
Aime yenge ye malicpongka welu ngakpi-kpolucine botoc balu woc-wiyacine badaingte, yogolec loling aiibong.
Yenge ubiyacte 9 kilok Yesu malicpongka weibong.
Welu ye yowawa loibong, yogolec fungine tafe kpisicna yanguc kwelengkeibong, “Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele ngictau.”
Ailu yenge kindololo ngic yaeckang, monic foleinapec nga monic kanainapec yeholec malicpongka momoc wecepaibong.
[Inguc aibong yowa Wapongte hibiwa kwelengkeicne fagac yogo noine fikewec,

Aime ngic-ngigac iwa lec-welec aiibong, yenge Yesu misulec aicnolu hodocngineng dudalingkelu yanguc miibong, “Kwele-sowac aigelegabeleng, gageicne Ibu-mac hembalackelu hadeng habackangte kwelina hatacmac banogale miing.
Gageuctihac baficnagulu malicpongkacni fotockelu wanong!”

Aime depec-baba ngic micne, nga Wapongte yefe-yowale wewedu ngic, yenge inguchac ye misulec aicnolu mingagec ailu yanguc miibong, “Ye ngic-ngigac gocne baficebacaigac. Nga yeicnebac nalic mi baficnagudaicte.

Ye Mesia, Israel nongileng ngictau gadecka, yakumac malicpongkacni wana. Inguc nganilu ngagesingkedabelengte.” Aime ngic yaeckang malicpongka inguchac wecepaibong, yeke inguchac yowa kwekwe aicnoiboc.
Yesu homawec
Wenac hewac-hewac 12 kilok aiyemewa, mac kundung kweme kundungti himong someckelu falu game 3 kilok mac awelewec.
Aime dameng iwa Yesu ye malac sugucnehac wackelu yanguc miwec,
Ye inguc wackeme ngic-ngigac emeina domaibong, yengelacni gocnedi yowa yogo ngagelu yanguc miibong, “Ngagegaing, ye Wapongte siduc-mimi ngic wacine Elaiya wacke-wasic aicnogac.”
Inguc mibong monicti gasacke lelu spans
monic balu waing hobecineholecka kpomuluckelu kpingka lolu Yesule micka lome feme yanguc miwec, “Wangec domalu nganinang, Elaiyadi kwesilu bamoctodaicte me miyac!”
Inguc mime domabong, Yesu ye malac sugucnehac hatacmac wackeme asuine ofewec.
Ofeme Ibu-macte kpoluc sugucne
yogo hewacka yefe wilengkacni fouckelu wame yaeckang aiiboc.
Aime hudu-baba ngic yengele damong ye Yesule haicka domawec. Ailu Yesudi wackewec ailu homawec, silicine inguc nganilu ngagelu yanguc miwec, “Foinac, ngic yago ye Wapongte madec hocne.”

Aime ngigac gocne yenge inguchac dalicka domalu pasi fikewec, yogo nganiibong. Yengele hewackacni Maria, wacine monic Magadalen. Nga Maria, ye Yakobos kpisicne nga Yosefe yekele nenggacnginec. Ailu Salome, yenge yengilangkac domaibong.
Yesu ye Galili prowinswa game ngigac yogo yengi hocne ye balaibelu mole-bafic aicnolu gaibong. Ailu ngigac gocne bocyac, yenge Yerusalem iwa yeholec hikelu ye nganilu gaibong.
Yesu longkeibong
Mac biyac aweleme, hombangte wiyac bamockenogale dameng bangkale weleme, Sabatle dameng bangkalewec.

Bangkaleme ngic monic wacine Yosefe, Arimateahocni, ye iwa kwesiwec. Ngic ye wactowaineholec, Yuda ngic-ngigac yengele Tutumangtowa, yogolec memba monic. Ailu ye Wapongte ngani-damongte wangec gawec. Yedi hangoc mikac Pailatla hikelu Yesule kponggbong banogale uwacnowec.
Uwacnome Pailat ye Yesu biyac homagac, yogo ngagelu kwatackelu hudu-baba ngic yengele damong wackelu Yesu biyac homagac me miyac, yogolec uwacnowec.
Uwacnome Yesu biyac homagac mime, Yesule kponggbong yogo Yosefedi banale micnowec.

Micnome Yosefe ye kpoluc madicnebenang monic fuli balu Yesule kponggbong malicpongkacni bamoctolu kpolucti wabungkelu dongesiwa balu hikewec. Dongesi yogo posa henebe gufuicna fawec, iwa kponggbong lolu posatowa monic kpalundungkeme yefine hedickewec.
Aime Maria Magadalen, nga Maria Yosefe nenggacine, yeke Yesule kponggbong lowec, mac yogo nganiiboc.

footnotes.text: Mira yogo yoc monic, sopinedi wiyac bocyac bacaigaing. Monic yogodihac waingkolec lalickelu nobong socka doic weme wadaicte.

Hibi esecne Mareko kwelengkewec, yogo nganilu iwacni kwelengkebong kwelengkebong ofewec, yengelacni gocne 15:28 iwa mi fagac. Ngic-ngigac yenge hibi kwelengkeicne yogo wosaelu nganibong Marekodi mi kwelengkewec mecne.
Spans yogo materes ingucne misa kpomuluckecaigaing.
Kpoluc yogo mac gbagbacne, nga mac gbagbacnebenang, yekele hewacka loicne.
